messages.author: Liam
messages.content_text:
july 6 Notes:


Today was a slow trading day that I did not trade because of work. I would have faded either way just because of how the high tf has been looking.
,
the overnight traded lower and we were reacting out of a bullish 4h fvg going into ny session, so my bias would be bullish. When 9:30 opened, we got an aggressive move lower sweeping a london swing low and then a fast move up by 10:00. 10:00 did offer a setup, but I would most likely not take it. 10:00 opened and manipulated 30 points lower and then made a bullish 1min rejection block that didn’t tap any pd arrays, but played out for a successful trade. If I were to enter, it would be because of all the previous htf narrative so it would act as a continuation, but it is not quite my model. There was a 15min fvg that got edged by the 10:00 manipulation down, and if that got tapped I would have taken the trade without a doubt, cause that would be good for my model.  (Screenshot 1)

messages.author: Liam
messages.content_text:
july 2 Notes:


I unfortunately took two losses today, and I think they might have been able to be prevented, but I am still happy with the trades I took.
,
Going into the day I had a really hard time identifying my bias, but by the time 10:00 came, I was bullish because we had rejected out of a daily fvg, and the 4h bullish close was good confirmation in my opinion. Price traded lower and gave a 5min rb that rejected off of a 5min cisd. I entered and got stopped out instantly because from here we were super bearish and I completely got my bias wrong. Should have trusted my initial instict. (Screenshot 1)
,
The second trade I took was a limit order, and it was a bit like trying to catch a falling knife, but if I had a bit of a bigger stop then I would have gotten at least breakeven, maybe a recovering win instead of a loss. The level was a daily cisd and we had consolidated right before hiting it creating el, so I put my limit and got stopped out right before it made a 100pt move. it is very unfortunate because I took it on micro charts, but on the mini it actually would have played out as well. No matter though, 300 dollar loss on the day. All I have to do is keep trading smartly. (Screenshot 2)
,
The 10:00 setup I should have been looking at today was shorts because we had swept overnight session highs and then we made an smt with pre market highs. 10:00 opened highers, made a 5min rb and traded lower, but once putting the limit on 10:00, we missed the trade by 5 points and then rallied. This is just the unfortunate reality of trading sometimes, but this would have also prevented that first loss today. (Screenshot 3)
,
I marked out one other level today and it delivered 200 points after tapping it and it was a 4h rejection block, and it was the same story as the level I took. We put in a swing low right before it, swept it and then made a big move up after tapping the level. (Screenshot 4 & 5)
,

Took longs today as i wanted to see upside after we sweeped london lows. NY opens and we manipulated down to that big 15 minute gap i marked, and it tapped the CE, 0.79 and a 1hr OB on the left side.

Today I did not take any trades because I was working and it was also a no news wednesday. The market did perform quite well, but with limited trading below the weekly open, I think we go back down there.
,
Today wasn’t the best trading day in my opinion, but price traded down after 10:00 opened, swept relative equal lows and perfectly tapped 18:00 open creating the low of the day. I would only limit this if there was more trading below 18:00 previous to this move. We also made a 5min rejection block off of it and I would enter off of this, but we edged the level before a very strong rally. (Screenshot 1)
,
So far, we have only trade 6 points below weekly open on nq and no points below it on es. This logic makes me believe that today may have acted as a manipulation for the week and we will distribute lower. The other idea is that we might enter a htf consolidation period, but I don’t believe we will be very bullish because there are no pd arrays in the current range that can help us deliver higher.
,
